items.prompt: An official government memo lying on a grey office desk: several typed pages with a round stamp and a signature, too small to read, a paper clip, a ballpoint pen, a cup of cold tea; fluorescent light, a window onto a grey city.

alt.ru: Служебная записка на сером офисном столе: несколько машинописных листов с круглой печатью и подписью, скрепка, шариковая ручка, остывший чай; свет люминесцентных ламп.
alt.en: An official memo on a grey office desk: several typed pages with a round stamp and signature, a paper clip, a ballpoint pen, cold tea; fluorescent light.
alt.pt: Um memorando oficial numa secretária cinzenta: várias páginas datilografadas com carimbo redondo e assinatura, um clipe, uma esferográfica, chá frio; luz fluorescente.
alt.es: Un memorando oficial sobre una mesa gris de oficina: varias páginas mecanografiadas con sello redondo y firma, un clip, un bolígrafo, té frío; luz fluorescente.
